name: KLM 1.6
context_scaling: Native 2,048 tokens (config.json max_position_embeddings 2048, rope_theta 10000, no rope_scaling block). The card states 2,048 as the model's context length and lists it as a limitation; nothing longer was trained or evaluated, so there is no extension recipe to record.
attention_variant: Hybrid: 18 Gated DeltaNet-2 linear-attention layers (4 heads x 128, constant recurrent state) and 6 full-attention layers at 3:1 (attention_every 4, layers 3/7/11/15/19/23). Attention layers use 8 query / 4 KV heads, head size 64, RoPE, QK-norm and an output gate. Residuals are Block Attention Residuals; a 5.41M-parameter n-gram memory (125,000 bigrams + 38,000 trigrams at 32 dims) sits alongside.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-15 from the trending crawl (trendingScore 80, page 2; repo created 2026-11-09, 1,270 downloads / 80 likes at crawl). WHAT IT IS: a 99M-parameter English base language model from MinimaLabs, the decay-stage continuation of KLM 1.5, trained on 2,048-token sequences over 128B ClimbMix tokens of superposition warm-up plus 80B stable plus 100B decay. It is a BASE model - no instruction following, no chat - and the card says so. PARAMS: safetensors.total 98,975,308 -> params_b 0.0990. The card breaks that out as 5,411,832 n-gram-memory parameters and the remainder as the transformer; active equals total because there is no routing anywhere. Dense-with-hybrid-layers, so architecture is hybrid-attention-ssm rather than dense. DERIVED (arithmetic): 24 layers with attention_every 4 -> 6 full-attention layers (indices 3,7,11,15,19,23), so kv_cache_bytes_per_token = 6 x 2 x 4 KV heads x 64 head_dim x 2 bytes = 6,144 B/token. The other 18 layers are Gated DeltaNet-2 with a fixed-size recurrent state, whose per-token cost is constant rather than linear in context - this is the bounded-state property, and it is why a 2K-only model is still interesting here: at 2,048 tokens the whole cache is 12.6 MB. flops_per_token_active = 2 x 0.099e9 = 1.98e8. HARDWARE GATE: passes trivially - 0.099B BF16 is ~0.2 GB, runs on a CPU (the card ships a plain-PyTorch path and a fast_generate with fused Triton kernels). EVIDENCE: five zero-shot benchmarks where it beats five peers, three of them larger. Beats GPT-X3-150M (149M, i.e. 50% more parameters) on ARC-Easy 61.07 vs 59.64 and ARC-Challenge 33.53 vs 31.31, beats LFM-2.5-230M-Base (230M, 2.3x the size) on ARC-Easy 59.72, HellaSwag 39.29, PIQA 63.38 and ArithMark-3 36.60, and beats SmolLM2-135M on all five rows. LOSES recorded: LFM-2.5-230M-Base wins ARC-Challenge 34.98 vs 33.53; GPT-X3-150M wins HellaSwag 46.16 vs 45.28 and PIQA 71.33 vs 70.18. CAVEATS: the peer columns are copied from the AxiomicLabs Open SLM leaderboard as of 2026-11-09, not re-run by MinimaLabs, so the comparison is same-test but not same-run and the harness could differ per column. All KLM 1.6 numbers are vendor claims. ArithMark-3 is a private-ish benchmark (dataset AxiomicLabs/ArithMark-3.0) so it is not cross-checkable against anything else in the catalog. The Intelligence Index 33.95 quoted on the card is a leaderboard aggregate, not reproduced here.

benchmarks.name: ARC-Easy
benchmarks.config: Card table, column 'KLM 1.6'. Zero-shot length-normalised accuracy via lm-eval 0.4.12, stated on the card. WINS vs every listed peer: LFM-2.5-230M-Base 59.72, GPT-X3-150M 59.64, SmolLM2-135M 58.63, KLM 1.5 59.68, void.1 49.32. Beats two models with more parameters (149M and 230M) on the same table.

benchmarks.name: ARC-Challenge
benchmarks.config: Same table, lm-eval 0.4.12 zero-shot. WINS vs KLM 1.5 32.68, GPT-X3-150M 31.31, SmolLM2-135M 29.69 and void.1 29.35. LOSS recorded: LFM-2.5-230M-Base scores 34.98, so the 2.3x-larger peer still wins this row.

benchmarks.name: HellaSwag
benchmarks.config: Same table, lm-eval 0.4.12 zero-shot. WINS vs KLM 1.5 43.74, SmolLM2-135M 43.22, void.1 39.46, LFM-2.5-230M-Base 39.29. LOSS recorded: GPT-X3-150M 46.16.

benchmarks.name: PIQA
benchmarks.config: Same table, lm-eval 0.4.12 zero-shot. WINS vs KLM 1.5 68.55, SmolLM2-135M 68.44, LFM-2.5-230M-Base 63.38, void.1 67.19. LOSS recorded: GPT-X3-150M 71.33.

benchmarks.name: ArithMark-3
benchmarks.config: Same table, scored with the official ArithMark-3.0 script per the card. Best in row by a wide margin: GPT-X3-150M 50.90, KLM 1.5 48.20, void.1 43.70, SmolLM2-135M 39.20, LFM-2.5-230M-Base 36.60. ArithMark-3 is a single-vendor benchmark (dataset AxiomicLabs/ArithMark-3.0) with no other catalog model on it, so this is a first datapoint rather than a reproduced win.
